facts.fact: Zaiq states that POPIA section 71 is in force and bars decisions with legal or substantial effect based solely on automated processing that profiles a person, which it says touches AI credit scoring, CV screening and fraud systems.

ZAF.note: No government use of AI is described.

facts.fact: Zaiq states that South Africa has no AI-specific Act as at 28 September 2026, and the draft National AI Policy was withdrawn on 26 April 2026.

ZAF.note: No sector AI system in service is described.

facts.fact: Zaiq says a draft National AI Policy approved by Cabinet on 25 March 2026 and gazetted on 10 April was withdrawn on 26 April, an independent panel was appointed in May to rebuild it, and a revised draft is targeted for comment in January 2027.

ZAF.note: No locally built AI model, dataset or computing is described.

facts.fact: Zaiq says the Information Regulator enforces POPIA and can impose administrative fines of up to R10 million under section 109.
Zaiq's status table lists POPIA as in force on 28 September 2026.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013

facts.fact: Zaiq says the Information Regulator enforces POPIA.

Zaiq says the Information Regulator's published guidance notes cover direct marketing, children's information, special personal information and elections, with no AI-specific enforcement action found.
